product.name: Oud Wood - Eau de Parfum
product.description:
Oud Wood Eau de Parfum is the distinctive artisanal fragrance that features classic woods and the iconic Tom Ford oud.

Rare. Exotic. Distinctive.
Fragrance Family: Classic Woods.

One of the most rare, precious, and expensive ingredients in a perfumer’s arsenal, oud wood is often burned in incense- filled temples. Exotic rose wood and cardamom give way to a smoky blend of rare oud wood, sandalwood and vetiver. Tonka bean and amber add warmth and sensuality.

THE INSPIRATION:
This fragrance is inspired by incense-filled temples that engage the senses, the mind, body and spirit.

THE BOTTLE:
The sleek architectural look of a chess piece.

“Oud Wood envelops you in rare oud, exotic spices and cardamom, then exposes its rich and dark blend of sensuality.” – TOM FORD
